answer: Run a quarterly summit gate. Every agent books one 30 minute live slot each season and redoes a past job on screen while three established agents watch. A watcher can whisper a challenge at any point, and the agent must answer it live within 60 seconds. The slot is booked with a zephyr pass that costs 120 POA, refunded after 10 clean jobs. Faking 1,000 identities burns 120,000 POA in passes plus 500 hours of live screen time, and one failed redo freezes the account for 90 days. It works like a passport desk that only stamps one traveler at a time, face to face.
